from fetch import Get2dMapTrainFold, Get2dMapTestData, GetSpectrumTrainFold, GetSpectrumTestData

level = 1
fold = 1

map_train, map_train_labels = Get2dMapTrainFold(level, fold)
map_test, map_test_labels = Get2dMapTestData(level)
spectrum_train, spectrum_train_labels = GetSpectrumTrainFold(level, fold)
spectrum_test, spectrum_test_labels = GetSpectrumTestData(level)

print('2D map train fold:', map_train.shape, map_train_labels.shape)
print('2D map test data:', map_test.shape, map_test_labels.shape)
print('Spectrum train fold:', spectrum_train.shape, spectrum_train_labels.shape)
print('Spectrum test data:', spectrum_test.shape, spectrum_test_labels.shape)
